frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Cost-of-equity estimation under CAPM is a three-input procedure: riskless-rate proxy, beta estimate, and equity risk premium. Beta is sourced top-down (regression) or bottom-up (segment-weighted unlevered betas relevered to target capital structure). Damodaran Ch.8 develops the estimation discipline; Ch.7 supplies the Rf and ERP foundations.
